name: Semight Instruments Co., Ltd.
summary: Semight Instruments Co., Ltd. develops and supplies test and measurement instruments and equipment in China and internationally. The company offers high speed communication test equipment, including sampling oscilloscopes, clock recovery units, bit error ratio testers, network testers, wavelength meters, optical test instruments, and transceiver ATEs; and electronic measurement units, such as source measure units, switch matrix units, and wafer acceptance test products.
